Your reels get views. So why are the DMs empty?

Usually it's not the content. It's the profile people land on after the reel.

→ The bio doesn't say what you sell or where you are
→ There's no clear way to book or order
→ The last post is three weeks old
→ The reel ends without telling people what to do next

A boutique in T. Nagar can fix all four this week.

Want us to look at yours? Book a free consultation (link in the reply).

post.linkedin_text:
Posting is not the hard part. Turning those posts into enquiries is.

Maybe this sounds familiar. "We're on Instagram. People like the reels. But the phone doesn't ring more."

And that makes sense. Because good content alone mostly builds attention. To get enquiries, the right local people need to see it, and they need a clear reason to message you.

So that's why we built the Growth plan at Loyara. It puts the content and the ads in one monthly plan.

Here's what's included, every month:
→ 8 professional reels, shot at your business on 2 content days
→ 4 static posts, 2 motion posters and 2 carousels
→ Monthly content calendar you approve before we shoot
→ Captions, hashtag research and scheduling
→ Meta Ads management on Facebook and Instagram, set up to bring enquiries
→ A monthly performance report and 2 strategy calls

It's ₹19,999/month. Ad spend is paid by you directly to Meta, so you always see exactly where that money goes.

Who is it for? Chennai and Tamil Nadu businesses that already know what they sell and now want steady leads. A clinic, a cafe, a showroom, a salon.

If that sounds like you, tell me what you're working on. Let's talk.
